text:
Mina: Heads-up: noticed a spike in embed-split events + quota alerts hitting prod last hour for mixed-dim payloads. Can we decide routing + attribution defaults for rollout?
Ravi: +1. Can you paste a sample request shape? are these many small dims in one array or huge arrays mixed with 768 vectors?
Mina: Example: clients sending [768, 1024, 1536] in one batch, then splitter kicks in and we get 413 & quota churn. infra-bot sent alerts: high split rate for tenant T-42.
Oliver: Our current runtime prefers preserving original order and splits by bytes. That favors larger dims first in some cases -> bad latency for small vectors.
Selena: Console question: if we change routing to prioritize small dims (fastpath), we need a dashboard card that shows per-tenant "small-fastpath-hit-rate" and estimated unit attribution. Otherwise SRE + Billing will be blind.
Jamie: Telemetry proposal: emit metrics embed_split_rate, embed_split_reason (bytes|dims), embed_estimated_units, embed_preflight_latency. Also add a tag routing_policy={small-first,large-first,bytes-first}.
Casey: Behavior proposal (short): 1) Try small-dim fastpath where a contiguous subset fits within route budget, 2) fallback to best-effort split with per-chunk attribution, 3) if preflight header present, return unit estimate and suggested split plan instead of splitting. Thoughts?
Ravi: I like preflight. Example quick API: curl -X POST /v1/embeddings?preflight=true -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"vectors":[{"dim":768,...},{"dim":1536,...}], "prefer":"latency"}' -> response {"units":24, "split_plan":[{"start":0,"end":1,"route":"fast-768"}]}
Mina: That solves client UX for apps that can re-chunk on client-side. But many customers rely on server-side split. We need safe defaults.
Selena: Console UX: show preflight-suggested-units in the route preview panel and a toggle "auto-split server-side" with a tooltip explaining cost attribution. Also add a small-toast in quota panel when server-side split increases estimated units.
Jamie: Rollout idea: ship preflight + metric first behind feature flag `embed-adaptive-routing`, enable for 5% tenants, bake dashboards, then flip server-side default for new tenants only. Old tenants opt-in via console.
Oliver: Runtime note: implementing small-first affects batching kernels (we'll need to special-case queue coalescing for mixed shapes). Cost might be a small perf regression on large-only workloads; we should gate by workload fingerprint.
Casey: Fallback policy: if split_count > 3 then fast-fail with 413 + suggestion URL to console preflight. Prevents runaway multi-split loops.
Mina: Agree. Add a meter for "split_count_exceeded" so we can alert before customer impact.
infra-bot: ALERT for T-42: 1h window: embed_split_rate=23%, avg_split_count=2.6, 413_count=18. See /alerts/1754321986/details
Ravi: Action items: (1) Runtime: add routing_policy toggle + emit tags. (2) API: add preflight bool + response shape for split_plan/units. (3) Console: route preview + opt-in toggle + quota toast. (4) Observability: new metrics list above + dashboard PR. I'll draft API surface this afternoon.
Selena: I'll mock console tiles and the quota toast. Can we have a concise copy for the tooltip: "Server-side splitting may increase billed units; use preflight to estimate cost and re-chunk on client for best latency." 
Jamie: I'll add the telemetry cards to the infra dashboard and create an alert: embed_split_rate>10% for >30m for a tenant -> paging.
Mina: Thanks. If nobody objects, start the flag + preflight API RFC. Quick poll: anyone object to preflight + small-first default for new tenants?
Oliver: No objection, prefer canary.
Casey: No objection.
Ravi: No objection.
Selena: No objection.
Jamie: No objection.
Mina: Great. I'll open RFC + gh issues: runtime, api, console, telemetry. Tagging @ravi for API draft. :thumbsup:
